h: Report says insecurity is worsening in Nigeria even as a stability index shows rising economic confidence
p: A new report reportedly shows insecurity getting worse across Nigeria, while a separate stability index points to improving economic confidence. The mixed picture is drawing attention as the 2027 campaign season gets under way.
more: The report is said to highlight kidnappings and attacks in several states.
Analysts say economic confidence and security perceptions do not always move together.
